prompt: The client wants to know why its cost per delivery rose. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Driver pay is the largest component in 2025, at $8
options.feedback: True, but the question is why cost rose, and that needs the change, not the level.

options.text: Driver pay added all of the $3 rise; fuel and vehicles cancel out
options.feedback: Right. Total cost went from $12 to $15. Driver pay rose $3 (5 to 8), fuel rose $1 and vehicle costs fell $1.

options.text: All three components rose over the period
A shortage of drivers pushed up pay
options.feedback: The chart shows pay rising, not why.

explanation: Total cost per delivery rose from $12 to $15. Driver pay rose $3 (5 to 8); fuel rose $1 and vehicle costs fell $1.

extras.proof: Total cost per delivery rose from $12 to $15. Driver pay rose $3 (5 to 8); fuel rose $1 and vehicle costs fell $1.
